description: Fix clearSessionCookie missing Secure flag and change revocation data structure from Set to Map for O(1) lookup
steps: In clearSessionCookie, add the same conditional Secure flag that setSessionCookie uses when CONFIG.trustProxy is true
Change _revokedTokens from a Set to a Map keyed by payloadHash with exp timestamp as the value
Update _revokeToken to use Map.set(payloadHash, exp) instead of Set.add({payloadHash, exp})
Update _isTokenRevoked to use Map.has(payloadHash) for O(1) lookup instead of iterating
Update the cleanup interval to iterate Map entries and delete expired ones
acceptance_criteria: clearSessionCookie includes '; Secure' when CONFIG.trustProxy is true
_revokedTokens is a Map keyed by payloadHash
Cleanup interval iterates entries and deletes expired keys
